key_idea: Line the birds up from smallest to biggest.
steps: Bird 3 is the smallest of all.
Bird 4 is bigger than bird 5, and bird 2 is the biggest.
From small to big: 3, 1, 5, 4, 2. The middle bird is bird 5.

choice_feedback.A: Bird 1 is the second smallest, so it is 2nd, not in the middle.
choice_feedback.B: Bird 2 is the biggest, so it comes last.
choice_feedback.C: Bird 3 is the smallest, so it comes first.
choice_feedback.D: Bird 4 is the second biggest, so it is 4th, not in the middle.
